banner.message: We use optional analytics cookies to understand how Carsens is used. Nothing is tracked unless you accept.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.placeholderNote: This is placeholder content. The full PDPL-compliant privacy policy arrives with the content management system.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: Account details you provide (name, email, phone) and the listings you publish. Technical logs are kept only as long as needed to operate the marketplace.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Essential cookies keep you signed in and remember your language. Optional analytics cookies (Google Analytics 4) run only after you accept them on the consent banner — declining keeps analytics off, and you can change your mind at any time.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any privacy question or request, contact the Carsens team through the contact details published on this site.
